name: Elgi Equipments Limited
summary: Elgi Equipments Limited manufactures and sells air compressors and related parts in India, Europe, Australia, the United States, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Air Compressors and Automotive Equipments. The company offers oil lubricated screw and piston air compressors, oil free piston and screw air compressors, rotary and reciprocating air compressors, diesel and electric portable air compressors, railway air compressors, heat recovery systems, and medical air compressors and vacuum pumps, as well as air accessories; air compressor parts, filters and separators, lubricants and fluids, and service kits, and other accessories; and air compressor service.
